actions.name: hold breath
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: multiple heads
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has five heads. Whenever the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

actions.name: reactive heads
actions.desc: For each head the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has beyond one, it gets an extra &Reference[Reaction] that can be used only for &Reference[OpportunityAttacks].

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes as many  [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] attacks as it has heads.
